purpose: Separate empirical stage startup reservations from unchanged hard process RSS limits for the explicitly requested host-memory admission correction.
sampling_scope: Direct contexts/**/result/record.json and evaluations/**/result/record.json under the four specified execution roots only.
A result is admitted only with status COMPLETE, resources.all_gates_passed true, model_released true, and an immutable corresponding exit record with returncode 0.
A successful stage inside an execution that subsequently stopped is counted only as that process sample; this does not change the execution closeout or imply whole-run success.
No running process, failed process or unfinished process is included in the historical maxima.
peak_semantics: Per-process historical resident set high-water mark reported by worker host monitoring; not task-cache disk sizes and not a sum across processes.
interpretation_limits: These 91 process samples are not 91 independent scientific trials: model, seed, parameter point, shard and implementation repeat across records.

The 44 class samples include complete shards and recovery-only remaining-task shards. Full shard01 historical peaks reach 124.5362434387207 GiB; V43 recovered shard01 reaches only 60.901100158691406 GiB and cannot stand in for a fresh complete shard.
Class CPU saved-activation and task-gradient processing is distinct from the global virtual-point coordinator; no class/coordinator budgets are inferred solely from model weights or GPU memory.
The three generate samples are limited endpoint coverage; no endpoint answer content or accuracy was inspected.
Historical successful maxima are empirical observations, not upper bounds or guarantees for future allocation, external-project growth, allocator behavior or unseen workload mixtures.
The proportional margin, absolute margin and rounding are conservative engineering choices, not statistically estimated confidence intervals.
No conclusion about a memory leak or allocator attribution is claimed; no new memory profiling or scientific replay was performed.
